summary: Iteration 67 — Frontend regression re-verify for the 3 blockers reported in iter66. ALL THREE FIXES GREEN. (1) CulturalEditionModal: clicking [data-testid='open-cultural-edition'] on AccountDetailPage opens the modal — [data-testid='cultural-edition-modal'] renders within 2s, backdrop carries [data-testid='cultural-edition-modal-backdrop'], ce-submarket-select is populated with 49 options (>10 requirement met), ce-create button present and DISABLED before selection, ENABLED after selecting 'usa_miami'. (2) CrmAccountsPage list now loads — 71 account cards rendered with [data-testid='account-card-<id>'] (alias confirmed). Fixture account 8e40f60c-1e91-4b4e-9d13-a52fc71c146a found in list. Clicking a card navigates correctly to /crm/accounts/<id>. (3) [data-testid='relationship-summary-panel'] is present on the right-column aside. Quick-action CTAs (open-cultural-edition + open-voice-note + open-followup) are positioned at the TOP of the panel (CTA HTML position 714, Stage row at 3400 — confirms CTAs render BEFORE the Stage/Health/Owner rows). Regression smoke: /workspace/leads → /crm/accounts redirect ✅, 7 canonical stage pills ✅, quick-add-menu shows exactly 9 items ✅, AccountDetailPage loads cleanly ✅, existing TEST_iter66 timeline entries titled 'Create a Cultural Edition™ · Miami' visible (display_name resolution via _sub_label working correctly — title shows 'Miami' not 'usa_miami').

issues: Minor visual overlap on 1920x1080 between the 'Aggiungi' quick-add dropdown menu and the Relationship Summary Panel CTAs — when both are open simultaneously the menu floats over the CTA buttons. Not blocking interaction (the menu is z-index'd above) but worth keeping in mind for future polish.

critical_code_review_comments: CulturalEditionModal <option> renders submarket label via inline expression which emergent's instrumentation wraps in a <span> — Chrome logs a hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Functionally harmless (49 options render, select works, value 'usa_miami' is set correctly), but the warning is noisy. If desired, precompute the option text into a plain string variable before render so no JSX expression sits inside <option>.

AccountDetailPage CulturalEditionModal is always mounted (open prop toggled) — fine for this size but if many modals get added consider gating with {open && <Modal />} to avoid running the submarkets useEffect prematurely. Currently the useEffect is correctly guarded with `if (!open) return;` so this is just hygiene.

CrmAccountsPage canonical testid is now 'account-card-<id>' (alias) coexisting with the legacy 'crm-account-card-<id>' on the underlying row component. Verified the new alias resolves to the same clickable button — both testids work. Consider migrating any internal references to the canonical name in a follow-up.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 3 regression fixes verified + 4/4 smoke checks pass
